influencer-marketing.title: Influencer Marketing Agency in Laos | CRE8
influencer-marketing.description: Hire a Laos influencer marketing agency. CRE8 matches brands with Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram creators, manages campaigns, and reports results.
influencer-marketing.lead: CRE8 is an influencer marketing agency in Vientiane. We find the right creators, brief them, manage posting, and report reach, engagement, and sales impact.
body: Brands in Laos win attention when a trusted creator speaks in the local language, on the platforms people already use. We run influencer campaigns on Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram — from one flagship creator to a network of micro-influencers.

Every campaign starts with audience fit, not follower count. We shortlist creators, check past content, agree deliverables, handle contracts and payments, and track links and views so you can see what worked.
offers: Creator search and vetting across Laos
Briefs, content review, and posting calendars
TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram influencer campaigns
Micro-influencer and KOL / brand ambassador programs
Campaign tracking, view logs, and performance reports
audience: Consumer brands launching in Laos
F&B, beauty, retail, and hospitality teams
NGOs and public campaigns that need trusted local voices

faqs.q: What is influencer marketing in Laos?
faqs.a: It is paid or gifted collaboration with Lao creators who post on Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram so their audience hears about your brand from someone they already follow.
We match location, language, niche, past brand fit, and real engagement — not only follower numbers. Vientiane, Luang Prabang, and provincial creators can all be part of a mix.

faqs.q: Can CRE8 manage the whole campaign?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle sourcing, briefing, content approval, posting, boosting, payments, and reporting so your team has one partner.

digital-marketing-laos.title: Digital Marketing Agency in Laos | CRE8
digital-marketing-laos.description: Digital marketing agency in Vientiane. CRE8 plans social ads, Google and YouTube buying, content, and 360 campaigns for brands across Laos.
digital-marketing-laos.lead: From Vientiane, CRE8 plans and runs digital marketing that reaches Lao audiences on Facebook, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and the open web.
body: Laos is mobile-first. We build media plans around where people actually spend time: Facebook for reach, TikTok for discovery, Google and YouTube for intent, and websites or apps when you need remarketing.
As a full-service marketing agency we connect ads with content, influencers, and offline events so the same message shows up in every channel.
offers: Digital marketing strategy for the Lao market
Social, Google, YouTube, and in-app media buying
Landing pages, creative, and conversion tracking
Monthly performance reviews and budget shifts
audience: Brands that need a local digital marketing partner
Regional teams entering Laos
Companies that want ads plus content, not ads alone

faqs.q: Do you only run ads, or also content?
faqs.a: Both. We plan content pillars, produce posts, and buy media so ads have something worth clicking.
We are based in Vientiane and run nationwide digital campaigns across Laos.

facebook-tiktok-management.title: Facebook and TikTok Management in Laos | CRE8
facebook-tiktok-management.description: Facebook and TikTok content management in Laos. CRE8 plans pillars, produces posts, boosts ads, and replies to comments for local brands.
facebook-tiktok-management.lead: We plan, create, post, boost, and analyse Facebook and TikTok content so your brand stays active where Lao audiences already are.
body: Most internet time in Laos happens on Facebook and TikTok. We help you plan content pillars, a posting timeline, and a boosting strategy — then we produce artwork, motion, video, and captions and reply to inboxes and comments.
After posting we review content performance, ads performance, competitor activity, and new trends so the next month is sharper than the last.
offers: Content pillars, strategy, and posting calendar
Artwork, motion, video, and captions
Boosting strategy and community replies
Monthly analysis of content, ads, competitors, and trends
audience: Brands that need a always-on social team
Teams without in-house designers or community managers
Advertisers who want organic posts and paid boosts together

faqs.q: Do you manage both Facebook and TikTok?
faqs.a: Yes. We treat them as the two core channels in Laos and adapt format, tone, and posting times for each.

faqs.q: Can you reply to comments in Lao?
faqs.a: Yes. Community management is part of the execute package, including Lao-language replies.

video-production.title: Video Production and Livestreaming in Laos | CRE8
video-production.description: Video production and livestreaming in Laos. CRE8 films brand films, social videos, and live events for Facebook and TikTok campaigns.
video-production.lead: CRE8 produces brand films, short social videos, motion, and livestreams for campaigns in Laos.
body: Short video is the default format on TikTok and Facebook Reels. We script, shoot, and edit content that fits each platform — and we can go live for launches, roadshows, and creator sessions.
Video sits inside a wider plan: the same asset can seed influencer posts, paid ads, and PR.
offers: Social-first video and motion graphics
Livestreaming for launches and events
On-site production across Laos
Edits cut for ads, influencers, and organic posts
audience: Brands launching a product or store
Teams that need monthly social video, not a one-off film
Event and roadshow organisers

faqs.q: Do you only shoot in Vientiane?
faqs.a: Vientiane is our base. We also produce on the road for events and nationwide campaigns.

campaign-management.title: 360 Campaign Management in Laos | CRE8
campaign-management.description: 360 degree campaign management in Laos: influencers, digital ads, events, roadshows, premiums, and reporting from one CRE8 team.
campaign-management.lead: One team plans the full campaign — influencers, ads, events, roadshows, premiums, and reporting — so every channel says the same thing.
body: A 360 campaign in Laos often mixes Facebook and TikTok, creator posts, a roadshow or retail activation, and printed premiums. CRE8 coordinates the brief, timeline, vendors, and results.
You get a single campaign owner instead of separate agencies for media, events, and influencers.
offers: End-to-end campaign planning and project management
Influencer, digital, event, and premium workstreams
Roadshows and on-ground activations
Unified reporting after the campaign
audience: Brand managers running national launches
Companies that want one agency of record in Laos
Teams combining online and offline activity

faqs.q: What does 360 degree campaign management include?
faqs.a: Strategy, creative, influencers, media, events or roadshows, premiums, and a close-out report. Scope is agreed per campaign.

public-relations.title: Public Relations Agency in Laos | CRE8
public-relations.description: Public relations in Laos. CRE8 handles media stories, announcements, and reputation support for brands, NGOs, and institutions.
public-relations.lead: We help brands and institutions tell a clear story to Lao media and the public — in Lao and English.
body: PR in Laos still moves through relationships, local language, and the right channels. We draft announcements, support interviews, and align PR with social and influencer activity so the story is consistent.
This sits alongside our wider marketing work, not as a stand-alone press list.
offers: Announcement and story development
Lao and English messaging
Alignment with social and influencer campaigns
Support for NGOs, government, and corporate clients
audience: Organisations that need careful public messaging
Brands launching with both ads and news
International teams that need a local PR partner

faqs.q: Do you work with NGOs and government?
faqs.a: Yes. CRE8 has worked with NGOs, international organisations, and governmental entities as well as commercial brands.

consumer-research.title: Consumer Research in Laos | CRE8
consumer-research.description: Consumer and market research in Laos: face-to-face and online surveys, interviews, focus groups, pricing studies, and competitor analysis.
consumer-research.lead: Before you spend on ads or influencers, we can test what Lao consumers think — with surveys, interviews, focus groups, and competitor analysis.
body: CRE8 runs quantitative work (face-to-face / CAPI and online surveys), qualitative work (in-depth interviews and focus groups), experimental methods (blind tests and observation), and business analysis (competitors and pricing).
Findings feed the creative brief so campaigns are relevant, not guessed.
offers: Face-to-face, CAPI, and online surveys
In-depth interviews and focus groups
Blind testing and observation
Competitor analysis and pricing surveys
audience: Brands entering Laos or launching a new SKU
Teams that need local evidence for a regional HQ
Marketers who want research tied to campaign design

faqs.q: Can research be done outside Vientiane?
faqs.a: Yes. Fieldwork can cover urban and provincial samples depending on the study design.
